grizzly bears is a 2/2, so if it already has 2 damage marked on it, the next time state based actions are checked it should die. If the lightning bolt was cast targeting grizzly bears, then 2 damage was marked on grizzly bears after the cast but before lightning bolt resolves, lightning bolt will fizzle because it no longer has a valid target. If 2 damage is marked on grizzly bears and then you try and cast lightning bolt targeting it, that's an illegal game action because before you have priority to cast the spell, state based actions are checked and grizzly bears dies. If you mean that 2 damage from lightning bolt is marked on grizzly bears when it resolves, then the lightning bolt resolves and grizzly bears dies to state based actions after lightning bolt resolves.
